limits_text: s.269ST(a) is a duty on the receiver of the cash, not the payer: the section reads 'No person shall receive...'. A payment made by the assessee is not itself a books-testable exposure for the assessee under s.269ST; it is a Form 3CD clause 31(bc) reporting item only (limb (a): aggregate per person per day).

Books test covers limb (a) (aggregate per person per day) only. Limbs (b) (a single transaction) and (c) (receipts relating to one event or occasion) need bill-wise/event linkage the books do not carry.
